data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: classroom
sections.question: classroom
sections.summary: a room in a school where lessons take place

senses.definition: a room in a school or college where a group of students are taught
examples: The students sat down in the classroom and waited for the teacher.
There are thirty desks in the classroom.

answers.answer: The students opened their books and worked quietly in the classroom.
She swam in the classroom after school on Fridays.
He cooked lunch in the classroom every day.
They parked their cars inside the classroom.

sections.title: exam
sections.question: exam
sections.summary: an official test of your knowledge or ability

senses.definition: an official test of knowledge or ability, usually taken at school or university
examples: She studied hard for her maths exam.
He passed all his exams and got excellent grades.

answers.answer: She stayed up late studying because she had an important exam the next day.
He ate the exam for breakfast before going to school.
She drove her exam to school and parked outside.
They planted an exam in the garden to see what would grow.

sections.title: homework
sections.question: homework
sections.summary: schoolwork that students do at home rather than at school

senses.definition: work or study that a student does at home, set by their teacher
examples: She finished her homework before watching television.
The teacher gave the class homework to do over the weekend.

answers.answer: She finished her homework at the kitchen table before dinner.
He cooked his homework in the oven for twenty minutes.
She wore her homework to school on Monday morning.
They planted the homework in the garden and watered it daily.

sections.title: lesson
sections.question: lesson
sections.summary: a period of time when a teacher teaches a student or class

senses.definition: a period of time when a teacher teaches a person or group about a particular subject
examples: She enjoyed the English lesson because the teacher told funny stories.
He has a piano lesson every Tuesday afternoon.

answers.answer: She paid attention during the science lesson and learnt a lot.
He ate the lesson for lunch at his desk.
She parked her lesson outside the school gate.
They cooked a lesson for dinner and served it with salad.

sections.title: library
sections.question: library
sections.summary: a building or room where books are kept for people to read or borrow

senses.definition: a building or room that contains a collection of books and other materials that people can read or borrow
examples: She borrowed two books from the library.
He spent the afternoon studying in the school library.

answers.answer: She went to the library to borrow some books for her project.
He ordered a meal at the library and sat down to eat.
She swam at the library every weekend with her friends.
They cooked dinner in the library for the whole class.

sections.title: notebook
sections.question: notebook
sections.summary: a small book with blank or lined pages for writing notes

senses.definition: a small book with blank or lined pages that you use for writing notes
examples: She wrote the new vocabulary words in her notebook.
He always brings his notebook to class to take notes.

answers.answer: She wrote down the new words in her notebook during class.
He ate his notebook for breakfast before the exam.
She drove her notebook to the park and left it on a bench.
They planted a notebook in the garden to grow flowers.

sections.title: school
sections.question: school
sections.summary: a place where children go to be taught

senses.definition: a place where children go to learn and be taught by teachers
examples: She walks to school every morning with her friends.
The school has a large playground and a library.

answers.answer: She arrives at school at eight o'clock every morning.
He cooked school for dinner and served it with vegetables.
She drank a large glass of school with her breakfast.
They planted school in the garden and watered it every day.

sections.title: student
sections.question: student
sections.summary: a person who is studying, especially at a school or university

senses.definition: a person who is studying at a school, college, or university
examples: She is a student at the local university studying science.
The teacher asked all the students to open their books.

answers.answer: She is a student at the university and studies three days a week.
He ordered a student from the menu at the restaurant.
She parked her student outside the library.
They cooked a student for dinner and ate it with bread.

sections.title: subject
sections.question: subject
sections.summary: a branch of knowledge studied or taught at school

senses.definition: a branch of knowledge that is studied or taught in a school, college, or university
examples: Her favourite subject at school is history.
He studies four subjects this term, including maths and science.

answers.answer: Her favourite subject at school is history because she loves learning about the past.
He drove his subject to the park after class.
She cooked a subject for lunch and ate it at her desk.
They planted a subject in the garden and watered it every evening.

sections.title: teacher
sections.question: teacher
sections.summary: a person whose job is to teach, especially in a school

senses.definition: a person whose job is to teach students, especially in a school
examples: The teacher explained the new grammar rules to the class.
She wants to become a teacher because she loves working with children.

answers.answer: The teacher asked the students to write a short story for homework.
She cooked the teacher for dinner and served it with rice.
He parked his teacher outside the school gate every morning.
They planted a teacher in the garden to help the flowers grow.
